seed.savedSkipped_other: Saved {{amount}} to rayfin/seed. {{count, number}} stored files couldn’t be saved: {{files}}

notices.fallback: {{reason}} The Data explorer shows local data only.
notices.unread: The app’s latest data model change couldn’t be read, so its local backend still uses the previous data model.
notices.unreadNoEntities: No entities show because the app’s latest data model change couldn’t be read. Its local backend still uses the previous data model, which has none.

seedProblems.title_one: The seed data has {{count, number}} problem
seedProblems.title_other: The seed data has {{count, number}} problems
seedProblems.intro: Nothing was loaded, so the local data is as it was. Fix these, then load it again:

rows.emptySub: The app’s own pages add data. Use the app in the preview, then refresh.

users.title: Local users
users.notListed: The local backend didn’t list them.
users.emptySub: Local users show up here once someone signs in to the app on this computer.

files.emptySub: Files the app stores in this folder show up here. Use the app in the preview, then refresh.
files.folderNameTitle: The folder’s name in the app’s code
files.orphanTitle: The app no longer has this storage folder. Its files stay here until you clear them.

preview.label: Preview of {{path}}
preview.saveTitle: Save a copy of the file on this computer
preview.noneSub: Fabricator can’t show {{type}} files. Save a copy to open it in another app.
preview.textClipped: Showing the first {{size}}. Save a copy to see all of it.
preview.pdfClipped: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} pages. Save a copy to see them all.
preview.fieldTitle: A field the app stores with the file

confirm.cantUndoPublished: The published app’s data isn’t affected. This can’t be undone.
confirm.refused: Other rows still refer to these rows, so they can’t be cleared on their own. Clear those first, or reset all local data.
confirm.refusedNamed: Rows of {{names}} still refer to these rows, so they can’t be cleared on their own. Clear {{names}} first, or reset all local data.

clear.title: Clear all {{entity}} rows?
clear.message_one: This deletes the only row of {{entity}} from the app’s local data on this computer. Other entities, the local users and stored files stay.
clear.message_other: This deletes all {{count, number}} rows of {{entity}} from the app’s local data on this computer. Other entities, the local users and stored files stay.

reset.title: Reset local data?
reset.intro: This deletes the app’s local data on this computer:
reset.users_one: Its {{count, number}} local user and their sessions
reset.users_other: Its {{count, number}} local users and their sessions
reset.usersAny: Its local users and their sessions
reset.schemaWaiting: Then the data model change waiting for your decision applies.

clearFiles.title: Delete all {{folder}} files?
clearFiles.message_one: This deletes the only file in the {{folder}} storage folder from the app’s local data on this computer. The entities’ rows, the local users and other folders’ files stay.
clearFiles.message_other: This deletes all {{count, number}} files in the {{folder}} storage folder from the app’s local data on this computer. The entities’ rows, the local users and other folders’ files stay.

deleteFile.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteFile.message: This deletes {{path}} from the {{folder}} storage folder of the app’s local data on this computer.

loadSeed.title: Load seed data?
loadSeed.intro: This replaces the app’s local data on this computer with the seed data in rayfin/seed:
loadSeed.deletesAll: The app’s current rows and stored files are deleted. The local users stay, and the users the seed data names are added.
loadSeed.deletesRows: The app’s current rows are deleted. The local users stay, and the users the seed data names are added.

saveSeed.title: Save local data as seed data?
saveSeed.intro: This saves the app’s local data to rayfin/seed in the project, in place of the seed data there:
saveSeed.ids: Anyone who opens the project can load it. User ids become {{developer}} (you) and {{user}} (the local users). Fabricator saves the change as a version in History.

deleteUser.title: Delete {{username}}?
deleteUser.message: This deletes {{username}} from the app’s local users and signs them out of the app on this computer.

access.defaultDetail: No access decorator, so this entity falls back to the Rayfin default of `authenticated: *` — every signed-in user can read and write every row.
access.publicDetail: An `@anonymous` grant exposes rows to unauthenticated callers (actions: {{actions}}).
access.scopedDetail: Access is narrowed by a row-level `policy` callback for signed-in users.
access.mixedDetail: Some signed-in grants are row-scoped by a policy and some are not.
access.authenticatedDetail: Any signed-in user can access every row (no row-level `policy`).

schema.noImport: Entity "{{name}}" is listed in {{schema}} but has no import.
schema.notAFile: Entity "{{name}}" is imported from "{{module}}", which isn't a file in this app.
schema.unreadable: Could not read entity file {{file}} for "{{name}}".

sqlSource.notDiscovered: {{file}} reads the table {{table}}, which isn’t in the discovered tables.
sqlSource.notDiscoveredAny: {{file}} reads a table, which isn’t in the discovered tables.
sqlSource.wrongShape: {{name}} isn’t in the shape Rayfin writes, so it was skipped.
